doc: Guard-flag D_80085F98 prevents re-entry into this init/kick routine. If D_800737A4 is nonzero, calls func_800584E4() four times (six extra up front when D_800869A8==0x1E0/480), then always calls func_80056948() and func_8005ACDC() and clears the guard.

globals.name: D_80085F98
globals.decl: typedef struct { s32 v; s32 pad[2]; } S_80085F98; extern S_80085F98 D_80085F98; -- field v (offset 0, s32) is the only accessed member; padded to >8 bytes so gcc uses %hi/%lo (with %hi reused across the adjacent load+store, %lo refolded on the later far store) instead of a $gp_rel scalar or a fully-materialized array pointer.

globals.name: D_800737A4
globals.decl: extern s32 D_800737A4[]; -- single hi/lo read-only access (D_800737A4[0] != 0 check); incomplete array forces %hi/%lo over $gp_rel.
